background: Newcastle Building Society is a regional mutual in the north-east of England, funded by retail savings from its branch network and lending on residential mortgages, with a savings-administration subsidiary that serves other institutions.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the society, so the filings are the only evidence. Capital is the weak spot, with CET1 of 11.7% and leverage of 4.8% both in the bottom quarter of UK building societies. Liquidity is sounder, NSFR of 154% in the top quarter and LCR of 189% just below the median, though LCR has fallen 23 points since 30 Jun 2024. The other ratios have been broadly flat to 30 Jun 2026.
